title: PAN
section: In case of multiple sources of income, more than one option can be selected.  [ 12. Whether mother/father is a single parent? (select one)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#12) It is mandatory to fill in both parents’ details, except in single parent cases. In case of death of either of the parents’/divorce/separation, the applicant should not select single parent as ‘yes’ and give details of both the parents for the purpose of this application.  However, applicants can select one of the parents for name to be printed on the PAN card as mentioned at S. [ 13. Father’ Name ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#13) To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. Married woman applicant shall give her father’s name and not husband’s name.  [ 14. Mother’s Name ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#14) To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. [ 15. Parent Name to be printed on the PAN card ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#15) Applicant to select one of the parents whose name is to be printed on the PAN card. [ 16. AO Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#16) AO code (Area Code, AO Type, Range Code and AO Number) of the Jurisdictional Assessing Officer must be filled up by the applicant. These details can be obtained from the Income Tax Office Or IT PAN Service Centers managed by Protean or Protean website www.tinpan.proteantech.in  [ 17. Representative Assessee](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#17) [ 18. Permanent Account Number (if any)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#18) PAN of Representative Assessee is to be given. [ 19. Aadhaar Number](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#19) Aadhaar number is mandatory, if PAN of Representative Assessee is not available. [ 20.Representative Assessee Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#20) In Part E, in case of persons referred to in section 303(1)(b) or Non-resident Indian or Resident but not ordinarily resident, it is **mandatory** to provide details of Representative Assessee having **Indian address.** [ 21. Contact Details](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#21) Mobile Number and Email address of Representative Assessee are mandatory. [ 22. Address for Communication](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#22) Applicant to select one of the options as applicable for dispatch of PAN card.
